independence.limitation: All twelve original PDF texts were freshly extracted, identified and fully read. Diagram/wireframe visual content and external literature/provider assertions were not independently validated by this inventory. No audit adoption is inferred.
independence.full_original_set_reading_basis: All extracted textual content, sequentially in bounded chunks. This is not full visual PDF inspection or external-reference validation.

authority_notes.finding: Originals identify themselves as proposed baselines/specifications; RA-001 is research recommendations for review. Execution authorization does not establish formal baseline adoption or scientific validation. No new adoption claim made.
PRD lists a planned COS-SPEC-002 among downstream documents, but no such original appears in the twelve supplied source set. No missing specification is invented.

authority_notes.source: COS-SPEC-004 section 15.3 p24; COS-SPEC-010 SAFE-02 p2
authority_notes.finding: SAFE-02 explicitly resolves ambiguous derived-synthetic wording: deterministic outputs from synthetic masks remain SYNTHETIC_GENERATED. This is an original-source resolution, not an inferred audit adoption.

authority_notes.source: COS-SPEC-005 section 15 pp22-23; COS-SPEC-008 sections 1/12; COS-SPEC-009 sections 1/17 pp1,14-15
authority_notes.finding: Earlier imaging endpoints are preliminary; SPEC-008 owns canonical REST contracts; SPEC-009 browser paths are separate. SPEC-009 discovery additions are proposals requiring contract review/client updates rather than silently existing endpoints.

authority_notes.source: COS-PRD-001 UJ-05 p13 and section 14 p32; COS-SPEC-009 section 2 p1
authority_notes.finding: PRD includes alternative-branch journey but classifies interactive multi-branch comparison P1. SPEC-009 explicitly refines P0 to two states within one history with sequential scenario switching; simultaneous branches remain P1.

authority_notes.source: COS-SPEC-009 section 15.2 p13; COS-HACK-001 directive; COS-SPEC-012 section 8 pp5-6
authority_notes.finding: Five-minute specification is adaptable rehearsal guidance. Hackathon directive states a maximum three-minute submission demo. Organizer rules/eligibility were not independently verified by this inventory.

authority_notes.source: COS-SPEC-006 section 21 p32, section 22 p33, AC-AI-16 p34; COS-SPEC-007 section 17 p17; COS-SPEC-008 section 2 p2 and section 13.6 p12; COS-SPEC-012 B22 p3 and section 7 p5; COS-HACK-001 directive
authority_notes.finding: SPEC-006 explicitly places Meta Model API interpretation in P0 and requires interpretation for an authentic longitudinal case plus a synthetic trajectory. SPEC-007/008/012 explicitly permit deterministic fallback and SPEC-008 says P0 does not require named LLM entitlement. The hackathon directive separately demands substantive Meta integration. A useful fallback does not alone prove completion of named-provider or competition requirements. Record the source tension and actual adopted scope/access evidence; do not infer adoption from implementation.

authority_notes.topic: Constrained-only P0 versus broader simulation proposal
authority_notes.source: COS-SPEC-004 section 2 p3; COS-SPEC-008 section 8 p6; COS-SPEC-009 section 4.5 p6
authority_notes.finding: Earlier simulation source contemplates explicitly unconstrained research hypotheticals excluded from clinically plausible comparisons. Contract/UI explicitly enable constrained mode only in P0. Missing qualifying source evidence must yield ineligible/insufficient_data, not default pathology or a hidden bypass.

authority_notes.source: COS-SPEC-008 section 6.1 p4 and section 13.1 p11; COS-SPEC-009 section 4.6 p6
authority_notes.finding: P0 observation-batch appends approved source-supported observations; synthetic records are worker simulation outputs. Editor cannot choose provenance, accepted status or revision; note input references verified private artifact. Product recovery should simplify source selection rather than removing source-evidence requirements or silently treating manual entries as authentic.

principal_visual_followup.method: Read-only pypdf/Pillow extraction of both original embedded figures, visually inspected via view_image
principal_visual_followup.finding: Original schematics specify one case/context/time owner, central viewer/timeline/charts and contextual findings/records/evidence; current research workflow fragments these surfaces.
principal_visual_followup.limits: No complete page-layout rendering or visual assessment of every other source diagram. PyMuPDF transient download was stopped; cached pypdf/Pillow extraction succeeded.
